screen.rohostility.info.title: Reinterpretation of Hostility
screen.rohostility.info.unlock_hint_1: Enter the Nether or click below to activate the hostility system.
screen.rohostility.info.unlock_button: Step into the Cycle of Hostility
trait.rohostility.revive.desc: Revives once upon death with full HP, keeping level and traits.
trait.rohostility.regeneration.desc: Restores 0.1% max HP/tick if unharmed for 8 seconds.
trait.rohostility.adaptation.desc: Adapts to 1 damage type (-10% per hit, floored at 50%).
trait.rohostility.apocalypse.desc: 30% chance on hit to weaken 1 gear/Curio's attributes by 10% for 5s.
trait.rohostility.destruction.desc: 40% chance to strip 1 buff; otherwise +10% damage per buff.
trait.rohostility.unreality.desc: 40% chance on hit to lower a random enchantment by 1 for 10s (stacks).
trait.rohostility.fortitude.desc: Reduces incoming melee physical damage by 70%.
trait.rohostility.plunder.desc: 25% chance on hit to apply x0.99 max HP for 20s (stacks independently).
